description: This Java file defines the DriverService class, which provides CRUD operations and business logic for managing Driver entities within a Spring Boot application. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting drivers, as well as checks for uniqueness constraints and error handling.

classes.name: DriverService
classes.description: Service class managing CRUD operations for Driver entities, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: listDrivers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all drivers.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Retrieves a driver by its ID, throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Creates a new driver based on the provided request object after ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: updateDriver
methods.description: Updates an existing driver identified by ID with new data from the request, ensuring constraints.

methods.name: deleteDriver
methods.description: Deletes a driver by ID, throws exception if not found.
